title: Filling an inspection: setting up each axle and recording values
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  • A template with a Per axle field.
  • Fill an inspection against it; have Single and Dual axles, and axles with and without brakes.
custom_steps:
1. Set each axle to Single or Dual and to Drum or Disc; confirm Drum/Disc may be left blank when the axle has no brakes.
2. Confirm a tire row on 'Outer + inner' (the default) records four values on a Dual axle (LO, LI, RI, RO) and two on a Single; a tire row set to '1 per side' in the template and a brake row always record two, left and right.
3. Confirm every value carries its own verdict chosen from a field menu (OK, Monitor, Not OK, N/A).
4. Confirm nothing is required (an empty value stays empty, not converted to N/A) and values accept numbers and characters, including the text N/A.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each axle is set to Single or Dual and to Drum or Disc, and Drum or Disc may be left blank when the axle has no brakes.
  • A tire row on 'Outer + inner' records four values on a Dual axle (left outer, left inner, right inner, right outer) and two on a Single axle; a tire row on '1 per side' and a brake row always record two, left and right.
  • Every value carries its own verdict, chosen from a menu on the field: OK, Monitor, Not OK or N/A.
  • Nothing is required: an empty value stays empty and is not converted to N/A.
  • Values accept numbers and characters, including the text N/A.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9106 (S8 — Record measurements per axle); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S8; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R10: “Each axle will be set to Single or Dual, and to Drum or Disc. Drum or Disc may be left blank when the axle has no brakes”
  • S8-R11: “A tire row on 'Outer + inner' records four values on a Dual axle, left outer, left inner, right inner and right outer, and two on a Single axle. A tire row on '1 per side' and a brake row always record two, left and right”
  • S8-R12: “Every value will carry its own verdict, chosen from a menu on the field: OK, Monitor, Not OK or N/A”
  • S8-R15: “Nothing will be required. An empty value will stay empty and will not be converted to N/A”
  • S8-R16: “Values will accept numbers and characters, including the text N/A”

Amended on 12 October 2026
S8-R11 changed on 7 October 2026 (Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, version 42 of 7 October 2026, read on 12 October 2026), after the PM's decision on SV-10877: only a tire row on 'Outer + inner' records four values on a Dual axle; a tire row on '1 per side' and a brake row always record two, left and right. The S8-R11 quote above is the current wording, and step 2 and the expected results follow it. The Passed result in test run #494 (developer tests) was recorded against the earlier wording.

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
